exposure: prolonged second stage of labor duration
duration of rupture of membranes greater than 18 hours
cohort: A total of 406 women with prolonged second stage of labor, from four tertiary hospitals in Ethiopia, were included in the study.
finding: Duration of second stage of labor up to 4 hours, under strict fetal and maternal well-being monitoring, was not found to be a predictor of composite adverse maternal or perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery was identified as a predictor of adverse maternal outcomes.
